games.name: Studio Lite

games.name: REALISTIC HOOD TESTING
games.desc:
Game Is in Alpha Stage – Expect Bugs

This game is a "hood" gun testing experience focused on firearms, vehicles, and environments. It is not a full-fledged game but rather a casual and experimental test space. This game is inspired by "REALISTIC HOOD GUN TEST," the Original "REALISTIC HOOD," and MiscGunTest. 

[How To Play]
- Choose from 150+ guns and test them all out!
- Visit the Firearm Store to customize your weapons with Optics, Lights, Lasers, Foregrips, and more!
- Spawn with a randomized loadout and engage in PvP battles against other players.
- Experiment with a variety of weapons, each featuring different calibers and mechanics.

Supported Platforms: Mobile, Tablet, PC, Xbox, and PlayStation

Credits:
*GFX Thumbnail / Map Builder / Importer: @nachoperezjuan
*Scripter: @watamelnKalashnikov

Many assets were imported, sourced from Toolbox, or remodeled.

Have suggestions, found a bug, or need to report an exploiter? Join the Community Hub socials below!

games.name: [PLATES🔢] Highway Legends
games.desc:
Welcome to Highway Legends! Experience the ultimate highway cut up simulator where the goal is to swerve in and out of traffic. Push iconic supercars, hypercars, tuners, track cars and JDM classics to their limits in this high-speed no hesi driving experience, or just go for a cruise with friends.

⭐ Leave a Like and Favorite to support future updates!
🚗 Join our group to unlock exclusive group cars!
📣 Follow the game to get update notifications!

💨 Game Features
• Swerve through dense traffic at top speeds to earn cash.
• Build your garage with a huge roster of detailed cars.
• Visit the customization shop to tune and upgrade your ride's performance.
• Race your friends and see who has the best reflexes!

🎮 Controls (PC / Console)
First Person: V / RSB
Handbrake: L Shift / LB
Clutch: L Ctrl / RB
Lights: L / B
L Blinker: Z / Dpad L
R Blinker: C / Dpad R
Hazards: X / Unbound
TMode: M / Dpad Down
TCS: T / LSB
ABS: Y / Unbound
Popups: B / Unbound
